milestone: CPU Bool values and scalar comparisons
implementation: Distinct Bool builtin, literals and scalar comparison AST/typed IR; signed/unsigned integer ordering and integer-representation IEEE comparisons in MLIR; existing continuation kernels and typed private result layouts, plus a separate Bool CLI entry. No changes to the arithmetic/conversion engines or scheduler/storage runtime.

contract.evaluation: left then right, once each; operand faults retain their source location
contract.float: NaN unequal, all NaN ordered comparisons false; signed zero equal; infinity ordered; no floating exception flags
contract.lowering: integer comparisons and raw floating bit ordering; no hardware fcmp
contract.precedence: calls/unary, product, sum, pipeline, comparison, catch
contract.tasks: Bool captures/results, ordinary and nested calls, cached awaits and existing TaskError propagation/recovery; distinct private value layout; handles remain handles

qualification.scope: Focused Boolean/frontend/task/numeric/Metal regression qualification, not the full 343-test suite
coverage: all six comparisons on all six CPU numeric types; integer boundaries and full-range random inputs
floating exponent stratification, adjacent encodings, signed zeros, subnormals, infinities, quiet/signaling NaNs and random bits
independent APFloat/wide-integer ordering and eight ARM FP environments without flags
all native Bool parameter pairs for equality/inequality
Boolean output, aliases, precedence, grouping, explicit chain rejection, no truthiness/conversion
reserved names across ordinary/nested scopes; typed operand/task/error/GPU gates and forged IR rejection
left-to-right operand fault location and settled cleanup
both outcomes independently returned through every mixed numeric/Bool worker packet family
nested and cached awaits, owned tensor recovery, impostor layout rejection and post-owner value validity
sanitized frontend linked only to instrumented syntax/semantics; generated runtime sanitizer qualification separate

remaining_gates: conditional control flow and logical short-circuit operators
broader values/modules and native library tooling
native distributed design discussion before implementation
qualification_note: The broad run passed the unaffected regressions; the four Boolean suites reached the final evaluation-order check and exposed an incorrect expected outer-cast column (3). The inner checked cast correctly faults at column 9. Only that test expectation was corrected, then all four Boolean suites were rerun in full and passed. Counts combine the latest passing result for each of 79 distinct tests.
